scientific_question: Can the existing 3-action 8-bit nonlinear factor learner directly admit the full native seven-action public original MiniGrid source semantics without lossy projection or hidden oracle?
expected_stop: NO. R7 input is one uint8 and actions 0..2. Real source R10 uses exact public 7x7x3 image, direction 0..3 and mission, seven actions 0..6; MG19 extends mission variants. Any 8-bit projection of full observation can collide; unsupported actions 3..6 cannot be silently mapped.
smallest_reusable_bridge: Source-only wrapper of unchanged pinned R10 DoorKeyPublicAdapter, validating all seven source actions, preserving complete canonical public before/after, actual selected commit/complete feedback and original public digests. Does not compress into uint8 or adapt MG19 extended mission, and never runs Farama.
test_plan: Read exact original R10 blob, verify Git source identity in code and Windows CRLF normalization
all seven actions accepted with source-selected feedback only; test action identity and exact frame bytes/hash, no source-private fields
two full public states with same front/direction/mission but different other pixel must have different complete canonical hashes, demonstrating alias risk in any front-only projection
invalid action, unsupported mission and privileged fields fail closed
one outstanding action, duplicate completion and wrong returned public details reject atomically where original R10 contract permits
pinned R7 rejects actions 3..6 and cannot accept full original public dict as state; no 7->3 mapping invented
fresh-process R10 source snapshot equality and externally tracked SHA with original world not stepped
controls: Exact unmodified original R10 public validator and its own transactional action ledger; no trained learner nor evidence of scientific superiority.
authorities: No FSA #83 first use, no original Farama environment, no accepted native promotion, no controller/queue/main or native repo source modification, no fabricated 8-bit semantic equivalence, no human review substitute.
stop_decision: If contract gap verified, next native developer must adapt a source-neutral *full public* predictive state with seven distinct actions and mission through independently reviewed source bridge, then qualify trained control. This gate remains NO-GO for direct R7-to-original-world plug, even if source-only transport tests pass.
